🚀 Release Notes – v1.0.1

This update focuses on improving the user experience, refining interface details, and introducing new functionality for a smoother workflow in BitSlug.

🛠️ Improvements & Fixes

  • ✅ Fixed status icon for pipeline items — icons now correctly reflect real-time build states.
  • ⭐ Implemented Builds Watchlist — keep an eye on selected builds and track their progress effortlessly.
  • 🐞 Fixed empty branch field — branch names now display correctly across all build views.
  • 🎨 In-App Settings UI/UX Refactor — cleaner design, better organization, and smoother interactions.

🌐 Read more

For more information, visit: bitslug-org.github.io
